content: There are five aggregates – the aggregate of material form, the aggregate of feeling, the aggregate of perception, the aggregate of mental formations, the aggregate of consciousness.

content: 1. The Aggregate of Material Form
source_content: The Aggregate of Material Form

content: Therein, what is the aggregate of material form? Whatever material form there is – past, future, or present; one's own or another's; coarse or subtle; inferior or superior; far or near – all of it gathered and grouped together: this is called the aggregate of material form.

content: Therein, what is coarse material form? The eye faculty… the sense-field of touch: this is called coarse material form. ⤵ Therein, what is subtle material form? The faculty of femininity… physical food: this is called subtle material form.

content: Therein, what is inferior material form? Material form that, for this or that being, is looked down on, despised, scorned, treated with contempt, disregarded, considered low, thought of as low, agreed to be low, unwanted, unattractive, disagreeable – that is, sights, sounds, smells, tastes, and things touched: this is called inferior material form. ⤵ Therein, what is superior material form? Material form that, for this or that being, is not looked down on, not despised, not scorned, not treated with contempt, but regarded highly, considered excellent, thought of as excellent, agreed to be excellent, wanted, attractive, agreeable – that is, sights, sounds, smells, tastes, and things touched: this is called superior material form. But material form should also be understood as inferior or superior only relative to this or that other material form.

content: 2. Classification According to the Abhidhamma
source_content: Classification According to the Abhidhamma

content: There are five aggregates – the aggregate of material form, the aggregate of feeling, the aggregate of perception, the aggregate of mental formations, the aggregate of consciousness.
source_content: There are five aggregates – the aggregate of material form, the aggregate of feeling, the aggregate of perception, the aggregate of mental formations, the aggregate of consciousness.

content: 1. The Aggregate of Material Form
source_content: The Aggregate of Material Form

content: Therein, what is the aggregate of material form? As a single class, the aggregate of material form is this: all material form is not a root cause, is without root causes, is dissociated from root causes; it exists with conditions, is compounded, is material; it is worldly, subject to the mental taints, able to bind with the fetters, able to tie with the ties, able to sweep away with the floods, able to yoke with the yokes, able to obstruct with the hindrances, able to be wrongly grasped, able to be clung to, open to defilement; it is neutral, without an object, not a mental factor, dissociated from mind; it is neither a result nor something that produces results; it is undefiled yet open to defilement; it is not accompanied by both thought and examination, not accompanied by examination alone, but without both thought and examination; it is not accompanied by joy, not accompanied by happiness, not accompanied by equanimity; it is to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by meditative development, and its root causes are to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development; it neither leads to further accumulation nor to dismantling; it belongs neither to trainees nor to those beyond training; it is limited, belongs to the sense sphere, does not belong to the fine-material sphere, does not belong to the immaterial sphere; it is included in the round of existence, not outside it; it is not fixed in its outcome, does not lead out of the round; it is arisen, and can be known by the six kinds of consciousness; it is impermanent and overcome by aging. This is the aggregate of material form as a single class. ⤵ As a twofold class, the aggregate of material form is this: there is material form that is derived, and material form that is not derived. There is material form that is taken up at birth, and material form that is not. There is material form that is taken up and can be clung to, and material form that is not taken up but can be clung to. There is material form that is visible, and material form that is invisible. There is material form that offers resistance, and material form that does not. There is material form that is a faculty, and material form that is not. There is material form that is a great element, and material form that is not. There is material form that is bodily or verbal expression, and material form that is not. There is material form produced by mind, and material form not produced by mind. There is material form that arises together with mind, and material form that does not. There is material form that follows along with mind, and material form that does not. There is material form that is internal, and material form that is external. There is material form that is coarse, and material form that is subtle. There is material form that is far, and material form that is near… there is material form that is physical food, and material form that is not physical food. This is the aggregate of material form as a twofold class. ⤵ (As this was analysed in the Chapter on Material Form, so it should be analysed here.) ⤵ As a threefold class, the aggregate of material form is this: material form that is internal is derived; material form that is external may be derived or not derived. Material form that is internal is taken up at birth; material form that is external may be taken up or not taken up. Material form that is internal is taken up and can be clung to; material form that is external may be taken up and clung to, or not taken up but able to be clung to… material form that is internal is not physical food; material form that is external may be physical food or not physical food. This is the aggregate of material form as a threefold class. ⤵ As a fourfold class, the aggregate of material form is this: material form that is derived may be taken up at birth or not taken up; material form that is not derived may be taken up or not taken up. Material form that is derived may be taken up and clung to, or not taken up but able to be clung to; material form that is not derived may be taken up and clung to, or not taken up but able to be clung to. Material form that is derived may offer resistance or not; material form that is not derived may offer resistance or not. Material form that is derived may be coarse or subtle; material form that is not derived may be coarse or subtle. Material form that is derived may be far or near; material form that is not derived may be far or near… and there is material form that is seen, heard, sensed, and cognized. This is the aggregate of material form as a fourfold class. ⤵ As a fivefold class, the aggregate of material form is this: the earth element, the water element, the fire element, the air element, and the material form derived from them. This is the aggregate of material form as a fivefold class. ⤵ As a sixfold class, the aggregate of material form is this: material form knowable by the eye, knowable by the ear, knowable by the nose, knowable by the tongue, knowable by the body, and knowable by the mind. This is the aggregate of material form as a sixfold class. ⤵ As a sevenfold class, the aggregate of material form is this: material form knowable by the eye, knowable by the ear, knowable by the nose, knowable by the tongue, knowable by the body, knowable by the mind element, and knowable by the mind-consciousness element. This is the aggregate of material form as a sevenfold class. ⤵ As an eightfold class, the aggregate of material form is this: material form knowable by the eye, knowable by the ear, knowable by the nose, knowable by the tongue, knowable by the body – which may bring pleasant contact or painful contact – knowable by the mind element, and knowable by the mind-consciousness element. This is the aggregate of material form as an eightfold class. ⤵ As a ninefold class, the aggregate of material form is this: the eye faculty, the ear faculty, the nose faculty, the tongue faculty, the body faculty, the faculty of femininity, the faculty of masculinity, the life faculty, and material form that is not a faculty. This is the aggregate of material form as a ninefold class. ⤵ As a tenfold class, the aggregate of material form is this: the eye faculty, the ear faculty, the nose faculty, the tongue faculty, the body faculty, the faculty of femininity, the faculty of masculinity, the life faculty, and material form that is not a faculty – which may offer resistance or not. This is the aggregate of material form as a tenfold class. ⤵ As an elevenfold class, the aggregate of material form is this: the eye sense-field, the ear sense-field, the nose sense-field, the tongue sense-field, the body sense-field, the sense-field of sights, the sense-field of sounds, the sense-field of smells, the sense-field of tastes, the sense-field of things touched, and the material form that is invisible, without resistance, and included in the sense-field of mental objects. This is the aggregate of material form as an elevenfold class.

There is material form that is taken up and can be clung to, and material form that is not taken up but can be clung to. There is material form that is visible, and material form that is invisible. There is material form that offers resistance, and material form that does not. There is material form that is a faculty, and material form that is not. There is material form that is a great element, and material form that is not. There is material form that is bodily or verbal expression, and material form that is not. There is material form produced by mind, and material form not produced by mind. There is material form that arises together with mind, and material form that does not. There is material form that follows along with mind, and material form that does not. There is material form that is internal, and material form that is external. There is material form that is coarse, and material form that is subtle. There is material form that is far, and material form that is near… there is material form that is physical food, and material form that is not physical food. This is the aggregate of material form as a twofold class.
(As this was analysed in the Chapter on Material Form, so it should be analysed here.)
As a threefold class, the aggregate of material form is this: material form that is internal is derived; material form that is external may be derived or not derived. Material form that is internal is taken up at birth; material form that is external may be taken up or not taken up. Material form that is internal is taken up and can be clung to; material form that is external may be taken up and clung to, or not taken up but able to be clung to… material form that is internal is not physical food; material form that is external may be physical food or not physical food. This is the aggregate of material form as a threefold class.
As a fourfold class, the aggregate of material form is this: material form that is derived may be taken up at birth or not taken up; material form that is not derived may be taken up or not taken up. Material form that is derived may be taken up and clung to, or not taken up but able to be clung to; material form that is not derived may be taken up and clung to, or not taken up but able to be clung to. Material form that is derived may offer resistance or not; material form that is not derived may offer resistance or not. Material form that is derived may be coarse or subtle; material form that is not derived may be coarse or subtle. Material form that is derived may be far or near; material form that is not derived may be far or near… and there is material form that is seen, heard, sensed, and cognized. This is the aggregate of material form as a fourfold class.
As a fivefold class, the aggregate of material form is this: the earth element, the water element, the fire element, the air element, and the material form derived from them. This is the aggregate of material form as a fivefold class.
As a sixfold class, the aggregate of material form is this: material form knowable by the eye, knowable by the ear, knowable by the nose, knowable by the tongue, knowable by the body, and knowable by the mind. This is the aggregate of material form as a sixfold class.
As a sevenfold class, the aggregate of material form is this: material form knowable by the eye, knowable by the ear, knowable by the nose, knowable by the tongue, knowable by the body, knowable by the mind element, and knowable by the mind-consciousness element. This is the aggregate of material form as a sevenfold class.
As an eightfold class, the aggregate of material form is this: material form knowable by the eye, knowable by the ear, knowable by the nose, knowable by the tongue, knowable by the body – which may bring pleasant contact or painful contact – knowable by the mind element, and knowable by the mind-consciousness element. This is the aggregate of material form as an eightfold class.
As a ninefold class, the aggregate of material form is this: the eye faculty, the ear faculty, the nose faculty, the tongue faculty, the body faculty, the faculty of femininity, the faculty of masculinity, the life faculty, and material form that is not a faculty. This is the aggregate of material form as a ninefold class.
As a tenfold class, the aggregate of material form is this: the eye faculty, the ear faculty, the nose faculty, the tongue faculty, the body faculty, the faculty of femininity, the faculty of masculinity, the life faculty, and material form that is not a faculty – which may offer resistance or not. This is the aggregate of material form as a tenfold class.
As an elevenfold class, the aggregate of material form is this: the eye sense-field, the ear sense-field, the nose sense-field, the tongue sense-field, the body sense-field, the sense-field of sights, the sense-field of sounds, the sense-field of smells, the sense-field of tastes, the sense-field of things touched, and the material form that is invisible, without resistance, and included in the sense-field of mental objects. This is the aggregate of material form as an elevenfold class.
This is called the aggregate of material form.

content: 2. The Aggregate of Feeling
source_content: The Aggregate of Feeling

content: Therein, what is the aggregate of feeling? As a single class, the aggregate of feeling is this: it is joined with contact. ⤵ As a twofold class: there is feeling with a root cause, and feeling without a root cause. ⤵ As a threefold class: there is wholesome feeling, unwholesome feeling, and neutral feeling. ⤵ As a fourfold class: there is feeling belonging to the sense sphere, to the fine-material sphere, to the immaterial sphere, and feeling not included in any sphere. ⤵ As a fivefold class: there is the faculty of pleasure, the faculty of pain, the faculty of gladness, the faculty of sadness, and the faculty of equanimity. This is the aggregate of feeling as a fivefold class. ⤵ As a sixfold class: there is feeling born of eye-contact, feeling born of ear-contact, feeling born of nose-contact, feeling born of tongue-contact, feeling born of body-contact, and feeling born of mind-contact. This is the aggregate of feeling as a sixfold class. ⤵ As a sevenfold class: there is feeling born of eye-contact, feeling born of ear-contact, feeling born of nose-contact, feeling born of tongue-contact, feeling born of body-contact, feeling born of contact with the mind element, and feeling born of contact with the mind-consciousness element. This is the aggregate of feeling as a sevenfold class. ⤵ As an eightfold class: there is feeling born of eye-contact, feeling born of ear-contact, feeling born of nose-contact, feeling born of tongue-contact, feeling born of body-contact – which may be pleasant or painful – feeling born of contact with the mind element, and feeling born of contact with the mind-consciousness element. This is the aggregate of feeling as an eightfold class. ⤵ As a ninefold class: there is feeling born of eye-contact, feeling born of ear-contact, feeling born of nose-contact, feeling born of tongue-contact, feeling born of body-contact, feeling born of contact with the mind element, and feeling born of contact with the mind-consciousness element – which may be wholesome, unwholesome, or neutral. This is the aggregate of feeling as a ninefold class. ⤵ As a tenfold class: there is feeling born of eye-contact, feeling born of ear-contact, feeling born of nose-contact, feeling born of tongue-contact, feeling born of body-contact – which may be pleasant or painful – feeling born of contact with the mind element, and feeling born of contact with the mind-consciousness element – which may be wholesome, unwholesome, or neutral. This is the aggregate of feeling as a tenfold class.

content: 3. The Aggregate of Perception
source_content: The Aggregate of Perception

content: Therein, what is the aggregate of perception? As a single class, the aggregate of perception is this: it is joined with contact. ⤵ As a twofold class: there is perception with a root cause, and perception without a root cause. ⤵ As a threefold class: there is wholesome perception, unwholesome perception, and neutral perception. ⤵ As a fourfold class: there is perception belonging to the sense sphere, to the fine-material sphere, to the immaterial sphere, and perception not included in any sphere. ⤵ As a fivefold class: there is perception joined with the faculty of pleasure, joined with the faculty of pain, joined with the faculty of gladness, joined with the faculty of sadness, and joined with the faculty of equanimity. This is the aggregate of perception as a fivefold class. ⤵ As a sixfold class: there is perception born of eye-contact, perception born of ear-contact, perception born of nose-contact, perception born of tongue-contact, perception born of body-contact, and perception born of mind-contact. This is the aggregate of perception as a sixfold class. ⤵ As a sevenfold class: there is perception born of eye-contact, perception born of ear-contact, perception born of nose-contact, perception born of tongue-contact, perception born of body-contact, perception born of contact with the mind element, and perception born of contact with the mind-consciousness element. This is the aggregate of perception as a sevenfold class. ⤵ As an eightfold class: there is perception born of eye-contact… perception born of body-contact – which may be accompanied by pleasure or by pain – perception born of contact with the mind element, and perception born of contact with the mind-consciousness element. This is the aggregate of perception as an eightfold class. ⤵ As a ninefold class: there is perception born of eye-contact… perception born of body-contact, perception born of contact with the mind element, and perception born of contact with the mind-consciousness element – which may be wholesome, unwholesome, or neutral. This is the aggregate of perception as a ninefold class. ⤵ As a tenfold class: there is perception born of eye-contact… perception born of body-contact – which may be accompanied by pleasure or by pain – perception born of contact with the mind element, and perception born of contact with the mind-consciousness element – which may be wholesome, unwholesome, or neutral. This is the aggregate of perception as a tenfold class.

There is internal perception, external perception, and perception both internal and external. content: Therein, what is the aggregate of mental formations? As a single class, the aggregate of mental formations is this: it is joined with mind. ⤵ As a twofold class: there are formations that are root causes, and formations that are not. ⤵ As a threefold class: there are wholesome formations, unwholesome formations, and neutral formations. ⤵ As a fourfold class: there are formations belonging to the sense sphere, to the fine-material sphere, to the immaterial sphere, and formations not included in any sphere. ⤵ As a fivefold class: there are formations joined with the faculty of pleasure, joined with the faculty of pain, joined with the faculty of gladness, joined with the faculty of sadness, and joined with the faculty of equanimity. This is the aggregate of mental formations as a sevenfold class. ⤵ As an eightfold class: there is intention born of eye-contact… intention born of body-contact – which may be accompanied by pleasure or by pain – intention born of contact with the mind element, and intention born of contact with the mind-consciousness element. This is the aggregate of mental formations as an eightfold class. ⤵ As a ninefold class: there is intention born of eye-contact… intention born of contact with the mind element, and intention born of contact with the mind-consciousness element – which may be wholesome, unwholesome, or neutral. This is the aggregate of mental formations as a tenfold class.

content: 5. The Aggregate of Consciousness
source_content: The Aggregate of Consciousness

content: Therein, what is the aggregate of consciousness? As a single class, the aggregate of consciousness is this: it is joined with contact. ⤵ As a twofold class: there is consciousness with a root cause, and consciousness without a root cause. ⤵ As a threefold class: there is wholesome consciousness, unwholesome consciousness, and neutral consciousness. ⤵ As a fourfold class: there is consciousness belonging to the sense sphere, to the fine-material sphere, to the immaterial sphere, and consciousness not included in any sphere. ⤵ As a fivefold class: there is consciousness joined with the faculty of pleasure, joined with the faculty of pain, joined with the faculty of gladness, joined with the faculty of sadness, and joined with the faculty of equanimity. This is the aggregate of consciousness as a fivefold class. ⤵ As a sixfold class: there is eye-consciousness, ear-consciousness, nose-consciousness, tongue-consciousness, body-consciousness, and mind-consciousness. This is the aggregate of consciousness as a sixfold class. ⤵ As a sevenfold class: there is eye-consciousness, ear-consciousness, nose-consciousness, tongue-consciousness, body-consciousness, the mind element, and the mind-consciousness element. This is the aggregate of consciousness as a sevenfold class. ⤵ As an eightfold class: there is eye-consciousness, ear-consciousness, nose-consciousness, tongue-consciousness, body-consciousness – which may be accompanied by pleasure or by pain – the mind element, and the mind-consciousness element. This is the aggregate of consciousness as an eightfold class. ⤵ As a ninefold class: there is eye-consciousness, ear-consciousness, nose-consciousness, tongue-consciousness, body-consciousness, the mind element, and the mind-consciousness element – which may be wholesome, unwholesome, or neutral. This is the aggregate of consciousness as a ninefold class. ⤵ As a tenfold class: there is eye-consciousness… body-consciousness – which may be accompanied by pleasure or by pain – the mind element, and the mind-consciousness element – which may be wholesome, unwholesome, or neutral. This is the aggregate of consciousness as a tenfold class.

As a twenty-fourfold class, the aggregate of consciousness is this: through eye-contact as its condition, the aggregate of consciousness may be wholesome, unwholesome, or neutral; through ear-contact as its condition… through nose-contact as its condition… through tongue-contact as its condition… through body-contact as its condition… through mind-contact as its condition, the aggregate of consciousness may be wholesome, unwholesome, or neutral; and there is eye-consciousness, ear-consciousness, nose-consciousness, tongue-consciousness, body-consciousness, and mind-consciousness. This is the aggregate of consciousness as a twenty-fourfold class.

This is the aggregate of consciousness as a twenty-fourfold class.
As a thirtyfold class, the aggregate of consciousness is this: through eye-contact as its condition, the aggregate of consciousness may belong to the sense sphere, to the fine-material sphere, to the immaterial sphere, or be not included in any sphere; through ear-contact as its condition… through nose-contact as its condition… through tongue-contact as its condition… through body-contact as its condition… through mind-contact as its condition, the aggregate of consciousness may belong to the sense sphere, to the fine-material sphere, to the immaterial sphere, or be not included in any sphere; and there is eye-consciousness, ear-consciousness, nose-consciousness, tongue-consciousness, body-consciousness, and mind-consciousness. This is called the aggregate of consciousness.
The Classification According to the Abhidhamma is finished.

The eye that is a sensitive surface derived from the four great elements, included in one's own body, invisible, and offering resistance; the eye – itself invisible and offering resistance – by which one has seen, sees, will see, or may see a sight that is visible and offers resistance: this is the eye, this is the eye sense-field, this is the eye element, this is the eye faculty; this is a world, this is a door, this is an ocean; this is the bright surface, this is a field, this is a base; this is a guide, this is an eye; this is the near shore, this is an empty village. This is called "the eye sense-field".

content: Therein, what is the mind sense-field? As a single class, the mind sense-field is this: it is joined with contact. ⤵ As a twofold class: there is mind with a root cause, and mind without a root cause. ⤵ As a threefold class: there is wholesome mind, unwholesome mind, and neutral mind. ⤵ As a fourfold class: there is mind belonging to the sense sphere, to the fine-material sphere, to the immaterial sphere, and mind not included in any sphere. ⤵ As a fivefold class: there is mind joined with the faculty of pleasure, joined with the faculty of pain, joined with the faculty of gladness, joined with the faculty of sadness, and joined with the faculty of equanimity. ⤵ As a sixfold class: there is eye-consciousness, ear-consciousness, nose-consciousness, tongue-consciousness, body-consciousness, and mind-consciousness. This is the mind sense-field as a sixfold class. ⤵ As a sevenfold class: there is eye-consciousness, ear-consciousness, nose-consciousness, tongue-consciousness, body-consciousness, the mind element, and the mind-consciousness element. This is the mind sense-field as a sevenfold class. ⤵ As an eightfold class: there is eye-consciousness, ear-consciousness, nose-consciousness, tongue-consciousness, body-consciousness – which may be accompanied by pleasure or by pain – the mind element, and the mind-consciousness element. This is the mind sense-field as an eightfold class. ⤵ As a ninefold class: there is eye-consciousness, ear-consciousness, nose-consciousness, tongue-consciousness, body-consciousness, the mind element, and the mind-consciousness element – which may be wholesome, unwholesome, or neutral. This is the mind sense-field as a ninefold class. ⤵ As a tenfold class: there is eye-consciousness, ear-consciousness, nose-consciousness, tongue-consciousness, body-consciousness – which may be accompanied by pleasure or by pain – the mind element, and the mind-consciousness element – which may be wholesome, unwholesome, or neutral. This is the mind sense-field as a tenfold class. ⤵ As a single class, the mind sense-field is this: it is joined with contact. ⤵ As a twofold class: there is mind with a root cause, and mind without a root cause. ⤵ As a threefold class: there is mind joined with pleasant feeling, mind joined with painful feeling, and mind joined with feeling that is neither painful nor pleasant… Thus the mind sense-field is classified in many ways. This is called "the mind sense-field".

content: Therein, what is the sense-field of sights? The sight that is the shining of colour derived from the four great elements, visible and offering resistance – blue, yellow, red, white, black, crimson, leaf-green, greenish, the colour of a mango shoot; long, short, small, large, round, circular, square, six-sided, eight-sided, sixteen-sided; low, high; shade and sunshine; light and darkness; cloud, mist, smoke, and dust; the shining colour of the moon's disc, the shining colour of the sun's disc, the shining colour of the stars, the shining colour of a mirror's disc, the shining colour of gems, conch shells, pearls, and cat's-eye, the shining colour of gold and silver; or whatever other sight there is, derived from the four great elements, the shining of colour, visible and offering resistance; the sight – visible and offering resistance – which one has seen, sees, will see, or may see with the eye that is invisible and offers resistance: this is a sight, this is the sense-field of sights, this is the element of sights. This is called "the sense-field of sights".

content: Therein, what is the sense-field of sounds? The sound that is derived from the four great elements, invisible and offering resistance – the sound of drums, the sound of small drums, the sound of conches, the sound of tom-toms, the sound of singing, the sound of instruments, the sound of cymbals, the sound of clapping hands, the cries of living beings, the sound of elements colliding, the sound of wind, the sound of water, the sound of humans, the sound of non-humans; or whatever other sound there is, derived from the four great elements, invisible and offering resistance; the sound – invisible and offering resistance – which one has heard, hears, will hear, or may hear with the ear that is invisible and offers resistance: this is a sound, this is the sense-field of sounds, this is the element of sounds. This is called "the sense-field of sounds".

content: Therein, what is the sense-field of things touched? The earth element, the fire element, the air element; hard, soft, smooth, rough; pleasant to the touch, painful to the touch; heavy, light; the touchable thing – invisible and offering resistance – which one has touched, touches, will touch, or may touch with the body that is invisible and offers resistance: this is a touchable thing, this is the sense-field of things touched, this is the element of things touched. This is called "the sense-field of things touched".

content: Therein, what is the sense-field of mental objects? The aggregate of feeling, the aggregate of perception, the aggregate of mental formations, the material form that is invisible and offers no resistance and is included in the sense-field of mental objects, and the unconditioned element. ⤵ Therein, what is the aggregate of feeling? As a single class, the aggregate of feeling is joined with contact. As a twofold class: there is feeling with a root cause, and feeling without one. As a threefold class: there is wholesome feeling, unwholesome feeling, and neutral feeling… thus the aggregate of feeling is classified up to ten ways… thus the aggregate of feeling is classified in many ways. This is called "the aggregate of feeling". ⤵ Therein, what is the aggregate of perception? As a single class, the aggregate of perception is joined with contact. As a twofold class: there is perception with a root cause, and perception without one. As a threefold class: there is wholesome perception, unwholesome perception, and neutral perception… thus the aggregate of perception is classified up to ten ways… thus the aggregate of perception is classified in many ways. This is called "the aggregate of perception". ⤵ Therein, what is the aggregate of mental formations? As a single class, the aggregate of mental formations is joined with mind. As a twofold class: there are formations that are root causes, and formations that are not. As a threefold class: there are wholesome formations, unwholesome formations, and neutral formations… thus the aggregate of mental formations is classified up to ten ways… thus the aggregate of mental formations is classified in many ways. This is called "the aggregate of mental formations". ⤵ Therein, what is the material form that is invisible, offers no resistance, and is included in the sense-field of mental objects? The faculty of femininity, the faculty of masculinity… physical food. This is called the material form that is "invisible, offers no resistance, and is included in the sense-field of mental objects". ⤵ Therein, what is the unconditioned element? The ending of desire, the ending of hatred, and the ending of delusion – this is called "the unconditioned element".

content: Ten sense-fields are neutral. Two sense-fields may be wholesome, unwholesome, or neutral. Ten sense-fields cannot be described as joined with pleasant feeling, joined with painful feeling, or joined with feeling that is neither painful nor pleasant. The mind sense-field may be joined with pleasant feeling, joined with painful feeling, or joined with feeling that is neither painful nor pleasant. The sense-field of mental objects may be joined with pleasant feeling, joined with painful feeling, or joined with feeling that is neither painful nor pleasant, or may not be describable as joined with any of these. Ten sense-fields are neither results nor things that produce results. Two sense-fields may be results, may produce results, or may be neither. ⤵ Five sense-fields are taken up at birth and able to be clung to. The sense-field of sounds is not taken up but able to be clung to. Four sense-fields may be taken up and able to be clung to, or not taken up but able to be clung to. Two sense-fields may be taken up and able to be clung to, not taken up but able to be clung to, or neither taken up nor able to be clung to. Ten sense-fields are undefiled yet open to defilement. Two sense-fields may be defiled and open to defilement, undefiled yet open to defilement, or neither defiled nor open to defilement. Ten sense-fields are without thought and examination. The mind sense-field may have both thought and examination, examination only, or neither. The sense-field of mental objects may have both thought and examination, examination only, or neither, or may not be describable as any of these. Ten sense-fields cannot be described as accompanied by joy, by happiness, or by equanimity. Two sense-fields may be accompanied by joy, by happiness, or by equanimity, or may not be describable as accompanied by any of these. ⤵ Ten sense-fields are to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by meditative development. Two sense-fields may be abandoned by seeing, by development, or by neither. Ten sense-fields have root causes to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development. Two sense-fields may have root causes to be abandoned by seeing, root causes to be abandoned by development, or root causes to be abandoned by neither. Ten sense-fields neither lead to further accumulation nor to dismantling. Two sense-fields may lead to accumulation, to dismantling, or to neither. Ten sense-fields belong neither to trainees nor to those beyond training. Two sense-fields may belong to trainees, to those beyond training, or to neither. Ten sense-fields are limited. Two sense-fields may be limited, expanded, or measureless. Ten sense-fields have no object. Two sense-fields may have a limited object, an expanded object, or a measureless object, or may not be describable as having any of these. Ten sense-fields are middling. Two sense-fields may be inferior, middling, or superior. Ten sense-fields are not fixed in their outcome. Two sense-fields may be fixed in wrongness, fixed in rightness, or not fixed. ⤵ Ten sense-fields have no object. Two sense-fields may have the path as their object, the path as their cause, or the path as their dominant factor, or may not be describable as any of these. Five sense-fields may be arisen or bound to arise; they cannot be described as "not arisen". The sense-field of sounds may be arisen or not arisen; it cannot be described as "bound to arise". Five sense-fields may be arisen, not arisen, or bound to arise. The sense-field of mental objects may be arisen, not arisen, or bound to arise, or may not be describable as any of these. content: There are six elements – the earth element, the water element, the fire element, the air element, the space element, and the consciousness element.
source_content: There are six elements – the earth element, the water element, the fire element, the air element, the space element, and the consciousness element.

content: Therein, what is the earth element? The earth element is twofold: there is internal and there is external. Therein, what is the internal earth element? Whatever internally, in oneself, is hard, solid, hardness, the state of being hard, internal and taken up at birth – namely: head hair, body hair, nails, teeth, skin, flesh, sinews, bones, bone marrow, kidneys, heart, liver, membranes, spleen, lungs, intestines, mesentery, stomach contents, and excrement; or whatever else internally, in oneself, is hard, solid, hardness, the state of being hard, internal and taken up at birth – this is called 'the internal earth element'. ⤵ Therein, what is the external earth element? Whatever externally is hard, solid, hardness, the state of being hard, external and not taken up – namely: iron, copper, tin, lead, silver ore, pearl, gems, cat's-eye, conch shell, stone, coral, silver, gold, ruby, emerald, grass, wood, gravel, potsherds, earth, rock, and mountains; or whatever else externally is hard, solid, hardness, the state of being hard, external and not taken up – this is called 'the external earth element'. The internal earth element and the external earth element, gathered and grouped together: this is called "the earth element".

content: Therein, what is the water element? The water element is twofold: there is internal and there is external. Therein, what is the internal water element? Whatever internally, in oneself, is water, watery, moisture, moistness, the cohesion of material form, internal and taken up at birth – namely: bile, phlegm, pus, blood, sweat, fat, tears, grease, saliva, mucus, joint fluid, and urine; or whatever else internally, in oneself, is water, watery, moisture, moistness, the cohesion of material form, internal and taken up at birth – this is called 'the internal water element'. ⤵ Therein, what is the external water element? Whatever externally is water, watery, moisture, moistness, the cohesion of material form, external and not taken up – namely: the juice of roots, the juice of stems, the juice of bark, the juice of leaves, the juice of flowers, the juice of fruits, milk, curds, ghee, butter, oil, honey, molasses, and the waters of the earth or of the sky; or whatever else externally is water, watery, moisture, moistness, the cohesion of material form, external and not taken up – this is called 'the external water element'. The internal water element and the external water element, gathered and grouped together: this is called "the water element".

content: Therein, what is the fire element? The fire element is twofold: there is internal and there is external. Therein, what is the internal fire element? Whatever internally, in oneself, is fire, fiery, heat, heatedness, warmth, warmness, internal and taken up at birth – namely: that by which one is warmed, that by which one ages, that by which one is burned, and that by which what is eaten, drunk, chewed, and tasted is fully digested; or whatever else internally, in oneself, is fire, fiery, heat, heatedness, warmth, warmness, internal and taken up at birth – this is called 'the internal fire element'. ⤵ Therein, what is the external fire element? Whatever externally is fire, fiery, heat, heatedness, warmth, warmness, external and not taken up – namely: fire of wood, fire of straw, fire of grass, fire of cow dung, fire of husks, fire of rubbish, lightning fire, the heat of fire, the heat of the sun, the heat of a heap of wood, the heat of a heap of grass, the heat of a heap of grain, the heat of a heap of goods; or whatever else externally is fire, fiery, heat, heatedness, warmth, warmness, external and not taken up – this is called 'the external fire element'. The internal fire element and the external fire element, gathered and grouped together: this is called "the fire element".

content: Therein, what is the air element? The air element is twofold: there is internal and there is external. Therein, what is the internal air element? Whatever externally is air, airy, the distension of material form, external and not taken up – namely: east winds, west winds, north winds, south winds, dusty winds, dust-free winds, cold winds, hot winds, gentle winds, strong winds, black winds, high-altitude winds, winds from birds' wings, winds from a supaṇṇa bird, winds from palm-leaf fans, winds from a winnowing fan; or whatever else externally is air, airy, the distension of material form, external and not taken up – this is called 'the external air element'. The internal air element and the external air element, gathered and grouped together: this is called "the air element".

content: Therein, what is the space element? The space element is twofold: there is internal and there is external. Therein, what is the internal space element? Whatever internally, in oneself, is space, spatial, a void, a hollow, an opening, a gap, not touched by flesh and blood, internal and taken up at birth – namely: the opening of the ear, the opening of the nose, the door of the mouth, that by which one swallows what is eaten, drunk, chewed, and tasted, that in which what is eaten, drunk, chewed, and tasted stays, and that by which what is eaten, drunk, chewed, and tasted passes out below; or whatever else internally, in oneself, is space, spatial, a void, a hollow, an opening, a gap, not touched by flesh and blood, internal and taken up at birth – this is called 'the internal space element'. ⤵ Therein, what is the external space element? Whatever externally is space, spatial, a void, a hollow, an opening, a gap, not touched by the four great elements, external and not taken up – this is called 'the external space element'. The internal space element and the external space element, gathered and grouped together: this is called "the space element".

content: Therein, what is the element of sense desire? Thinking connected with sense desire – thought, intention, fixing, focusing, directing the mind, wrong intention – this is called the element of sense desire. Taking the Avīci hell as the lower limit and the gods who wield power over others' creations as the upper limit, whatever within this range moves here and is included here – the aggregates, elements, and sense-fields, material form, feeling, perception, mental formations, and consciousness – this is called "the element of sense desire". ⤵ Therein, what is the element of ill will? Thinking connected with ill will – thought… wrong intention – this is called "the element of ill will". Or the mind's irritation over the ten grounds for resentment: hostility, resistance, opposition; anger, rage, fury; hatred, ill feeling, malice; the mind's vexation, mental resentment; anger, being angry, the state of being angry; hatred, hating, the state of hating; vexation, being vexed; opposition, hostility; ferocity, harshness, and the mind's displeasure – this is called "the element of ill will". ⤵ Therein, what is the element of cruelty? Thinking connected with cruelty – thought… wrong intention – this is called "the element of cruelty". Here someone harms living beings with a hand, a clod, a stick, a knife, a rope, or with one thing or another; such tormenting, harassing, hurting, injuring, provoking, and attacking of others – this is called "the element of cruelty". ⤵ Therein, what is the element of renunciation? Thinking connected with renunciation – thought… right intention – this is called "the element of renunciation". Indeed, all wholesome states are "the element of renunciation". ⤵ Therein, what is the element of goodwill? Thinking connected with goodwill – thought… right intention – this is called "the element of goodwill". Loving-kindness towards living beings, the act of loving, the state of loving, the liberation of mind through loving-kindness – this is called "the element of goodwill". ⤵ Therein, what is the element of harmlessness? Thinking connected with harmlessness – thought, intention, fixing, focusing, directing the mind, right intention – this is called "the element of harmlessness". Compassion towards living beings, the act of compassion, the state of compassion, the liberation of mind through compassion – this is called "the element of harmlessness".

Here someone harms living beings with a hand, a clod, a stick, a knife, a rope, or with one thing or another; such tormenting, harassing, hurting, injuring, provoking, and attacking of others – this is called "the element of cruelty".

Compassion towards living beings, the act of compassion, the state of compassion, the liberation of mind through compassion – this is called "the element of harmlessness".
These are the six elements.
Thus these three sets of six, gathered and grouped together, make eighteen elements.

content: Therein, what is the eye element? The eye that is a sensitive surface derived from the four great elements… this is an empty village – this is called "the eye element". ⤵ Therein, what is the element of sights? The sight that is the shining of colour derived from the four great elements… this is the element of sights – this is called "the element of sights". ⤵ Therein, what is the eye-consciousness element? Depending on the eye and sights there arises mind, mentality, mental activity, heart, the bright one, mind, the mind sense-field, the mind faculty, consciousness, the aggregate of consciousness, and the corresponding eye-consciousness element – this is called "the eye-consciousness element". ⤵ Therein, what is the ear element? The ear that is a sensitive surface derived from the four great elements… this is an empty village – this is called "the ear element". ⤵ Therein, what is the element of sounds? The sound that is derived from the four great elements, invisible and offering resistance… this is the element of sounds – this is called "the element of sounds". ⤵ Therein, what is the ear-consciousness element? Depending on the ear and sounds there arises mind, mentality, mental activity, heart, the bright one, mind, the mind sense-field, the mind faculty, consciousness, the aggregate of consciousness, and the corresponding ear-consciousness element – this is called "the ear-consciousness element". ⤵ Therein, what is the nose element? The nose that is a sensitive surface derived from the four great elements… this is an empty village – this is called "the nose element". ⤵ Therein, what is the element of smells? The smell that is derived from the four great elements, invisible and offering resistance… this is the element of smells – this is called "the element of smells". ⤵ Therein, what is the nose-consciousness element? Depending on the nose and smells there arises mind, mentality, mental activity, heart, the bright one, mind, the mind sense-field, the mind faculty, consciousness, the aggregate of consciousness, and the corresponding nose-consciousness element – this is called "the nose-consciousness element". ⤵ Therein, what is the tongue element? The tongue that is a sensitive surface derived from the four great elements… this is an empty village – this is called "the tongue element". ⤵ Therein, what is the element of tastes? The taste that is derived from the four great elements, invisible and offering resistance… this is the element of tastes – this is called "the element of tastes". ⤵ Therein, what is the tongue-consciousness element? Depending on the tongue and tastes there arises mind, mentality, mental activity, heart, the bright one, mind, the mind sense-field, the mind faculty, consciousness, the aggregate of consciousness, and the corresponding tongue-consciousness element – this is called "the tongue-consciousness element". ⤵ Therein, what is the body element? The body that is a sensitive surface derived from the four great elements… this is an empty village – this is called "the body element". ⤵ Therein, what is the element of things touched? The earth element… this is the element of things touched – this is called "the element of things touched". ⤵ Therein, what is the body-consciousness element? Depending on the body and things touched there arises mind, mentality, mental activity, heart, the bright one, mind, the mind sense-field, the mind faculty, consciousness, the aggregate of consciousness, and the corresponding body-consciousness element – this is called "the body-consciousness element". ⤵ Therein, what is the mind element? Immediately after the arising and ceasing of the eye-consciousness element there arises mind, mentality, mental activity, heart, the bright one, mind, the mind sense-field, the mind faculty, consciousness, the aggregate of consciousness, and the corresponding mind element; immediately after the arising and ceasing of the ear-consciousness element… of the nose-consciousness element… of the tongue-consciousness element… of the body-consciousness element there arises mind, mentality, mental activity, heart, the bright one, mind, the mind sense-field, the mind faculty, consciousness, the aggregate of consciousness, and the corresponding mind element; or, at the first turning of attention towards any object whatever there arises mind, mentality, mental activity, heart, the bright one, mind, the mind sense-field, the mind faculty, consciousness, the aggregate of consciousness, and the corresponding mind element – this is called "the mind element". ⤵ Therein, what is the element of mental objects? The aggregate of feeling, the aggregate of perception, the aggregate of mental formations, the material form that is invisible and offers no resistance and is included in the sense-field of mental objects, and the unconditioned element. ⤵ Therein, what is the aggregate of feeling? As a single class, the aggregate of feeling is joined with contact. As a twofold class: there is feeling with a root cause, and feeling without one. As a threefold class: there is wholesome feeling, unwholesome feeling, and neutral feeling… thus the aggregate of feeling is classified up to ten ways… thus the aggregate of feeling is classified in many ways. This is called "the aggregate of feeling". ⤵ Therein, what is the aggregate of perception? As a single class, the aggregate of perception is joined with contact. As a twofold class: there is perception with a root cause, and perception without one. As a threefold class: there is wholesome perception, unwholesome perception, and neutral perception… thus the aggregate of perception is classified up to ten ways… thus the aggregate of perception is classified in many ways. This is called "the aggregate of perception". ⤵ Therein, what is the aggregate of mental formations? As a single class, the aggregate of mental formations is joined with mind. As a twofold class: there are formations that are root causes, and formations that are not. As a threefold class: there are wholesome formations, unwholesome formations, and neutral formations… thus the aggregate of mental formations is classified up to ten ways… thus the aggregate of mental formations is classified in many ways. This is called "the aggregate of mental formations". ⤵ Therein, what is the material form that is invisible, offers no resistance, and is included in the sense-field of mental objects? The faculty of femininity… physical food – this is called the material form that is "invisible, offers no resistance, and is included in the sense-field of mental objects". ⤵ Therein, what is the unconditioned element? The ending of desire, the ending of hatred, and the ending of delusion – this is called "the unconditioned element". This is called "the element of mental objects". ⤵ Therein, what is the mind-consciousness element? Immediately after the arising and ceasing of the eye-consciousness element there arises the mind element, and immediately after the arising and ceasing of the mind element there arises mind, mentality, mental activity… and the corresponding mind-consciousness element; immediately after the arising and ceasing of the ear-consciousness element… of the nose-consciousness element… of the tongue-consciousness element… of the body-consciousness element there arises the mind element, and immediately after the arising and ceasing of that mind element there arises mind, mentality, mental activity… and the corresponding mind-consciousness element; and depending on the mind and mental objects there arises mind, mentality, mental activity, heart, the bright one, mind, the mind sense-field, the mind faculty, consciousness, the aggregate of consciousness, and the corresponding mind-consciousness element – this is called "the mind-consciousness element".

content: 1. The Triads
source_content: The Triads

content: Sixteen elements are neutral. Two elements may be wholesome, unwholesome, or neutral. Ten elements cannot be described as joined with pleasant feeling, joined with painful feeling, or joined with feeling that is neither painful nor pleasant. Five elements are joined with feeling that is neither painful nor pleasant. The body-consciousness element may be joined with pleasant feeling or with painful feeling. The mind-consciousness element may be joined with pleasant feeling, with painful feeling, or with feeling that is neither painful nor pleasant. The element of mental objects may be joined with pleasant feeling, with painful feeling, or with feeling that is neither painful nor pleasant, or may not be describable as joined with any of these. ⤵ Ten elements are neither results nor things that produce results. Five elements are results. The mind element may be a result, or neither a result nor something that produces results. Two elements may be results, may produce results, or may be neither. ⤵ Ten elements are taken up at birth and able to be clung to. The element of sounds is not taken up but able to be clung to. Five elements may be taken up and able to be clung to, or not taken up but able to be clung to. Two elements may be taken up and able to be clung to, not taken up but able to be clung to, or neither taken up nor able to be clung to. ⤵ Sixteen elements are undefiled yet open to defilement. Two elements may be defiled and open to defilement, undefiled yet open to defilement, or neither defiled nor open to defilement. Fifteen elements are without thought and examination. The mind element has both thought and examination. The mind-consciousness element may have both thought and examination, examination only, or neither. The element of mental objects may have both thought and examination, examination only, or neither, or may not be describable as any of these. Ten elements cannot be described as accompanied by joy, by happiness, or by equanimity. Five elements are accompanied by equanimity. The body-consciousness element is not accompanied by joy; it may be accompanied by happiness or not; it is not accompanied by equanimity; or it may not be describable as "accompanied by happiness". Two elements may be accompanied by joy, by happiness, or by equanimity, or may not be describable as accompanied by any of these. ⤵ Sixteen elements are to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by meditative development. Two elements may be abandoned by seeing, by development, or by neither. Sixteen elements have root causes to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by development. Two elements may have root causes to be abandoned by seeing, root causes to be abandoned by development, or root causes to be abandoned by neither. Sixteen elements neither lead to further accumulation nor to dismantling. Two elements may lead to accumulation, to dismantling, or to neither. Sixteen elements belong neither to trainees nor to those beyond training. Two elements may belong to trainees, to those beyond training, or to neither. ⤵ Sixteen elements are limited. Two elements may be limited, expanded, or measureless. Ten elements have no object. Six elements have a limited object. Two elements may have a limited object, an expanded object, or a measureless object, or may not be describable as having any of these. Sixteen elements are middling. Two elements may be inferior, middling, or superior. Sixteen elements are not fixed in their outcome. Two elements may be fixed in wrongness, fixed in rightness, or not fixed. ⤵ Ten elements have no object. Six elements cannot be described as having the path as their object, the path as their cause, or the path as their dominant factor. Two elements may have the path as their object, the path as their cause, or the path as their dominant factor, or may not be describable as any of these. content: 1. Classification According to the Discourses
source_content: Classification According to the Discourses

content: There are four noble truths – the noble truth of suffering, the noble truth of the origin of suffering, the noble truth of the ending of suffering, and the noble truth of the way leading to the ending of suffering.
source_content: There are four noble truths – the noble truth of suffering, the noble truth of the origin of suffering, the noble truth of the ending of suffering, and the noble truth of the way leading to the ending of suffering.

content: 1. The Truth of Suffering
source_content: The Truth of Suffering

content: Therein, what is the noble truth of suffering? Birth is suffering, aging is suffering, death is suffering; sorrow, lamentation, pain, sadness, and despair are suffering; association with what is disliked is suffering; separation from what is loved is suffering; not getting what one wants is also suffering; in brief, the five aggregates that are clung to are suffering.

content: Therein, what is birth? The birth of this or that being into this or that order of beings – the being born, the descent, the coming forth, the appearance of the aggregates, the acquiring of the sense-fields – this is called "birth".
source_content: Therein, what is birth? The birth of this or that being into this or that order of beings – the being born, the descent, the coming forth, the appearance of the aggregates, the acquiring of the sense-fields – this is called "birth".

content: Therein, what is aging? The aging of this or that being in this or that order of beings – the growing old, brokenness of teeth, greyness of hair, wrinkling of skin, the decline of the life span, the ripening of the faculties – this is called "aging".
source_content: Therein, what is aging? The aging of this or that being in this or that order of beings – the growing old, brokenness of teeth, greyness of hair, wrinkling of skin, the decline of the life span, the ripening of the faculties – this is called "aging".

content: Therein, what is death? The passing of this or that being from this or that order of beings – the passing away, the breaking up, the disappearance, mortality, death, the completion of one's time, the breaking up of the aggregates, the laying down of the body, the cutting off of the life faculty – this is called "death".

The passing of this or that being from this or that order of beings – the passing away, the breaking up, the disappearance, mortality, death, the completion of one's time, the breaking up of the aggregates, the laying down of the body, the cutting off of the life faculty – this is called "death".

content: Therein, what is sorrow? When someone is touched by loss of relatives, loss of wealth, loss through illness, loss of virtue, or loss of view, when someone meets with one misfortune or another, is touched by one painful thing or another – the sorrow, the sorrowing, the state of sorrow, inner sorrow, deep inner sorrow, the burning of the mind, sadness, the dart of sorrow – this is called "sorrow".

content: Therein, what is lamentation? When someone is touched by loss of relatives, loss of wealth, loss through illness, loss of virtue, or loss of view, when someone meets with one misfortune or another, is touched by one painful thing or another – the crying out, the lamenting, the act of crying out, the act of lamenting, the state of crying out, the state of lamenting; the talk, the raving, the wailing; the moaning, the act of moaning, the state of moaning – this is called "lamentation".

content: Therein, what is the suffering of association with what is disliked? Here, whatever sights, sounds, smells, tastes, and things touched are unwanted, unattractive, and disagreeable to someone, or whoever wishes them ill, wishes them harm, wishes them discomfort, wishes them no security – meeting, coming together, joining, and mingling with these – this is called "the suffering of association with what is disliked".

content: Therein, what is the suffering of separation from what is loved? Here, whatever sights, sounds, smells, tastes, and things touched are wanted, attractive, and agreeable to someone, or whoever wishes them well, wishes them good, wishes them comfort, wishes them security – mother or father, brother or sister, friends or companions, relatives or kin – not meeting, not coming together, not joining, and not mingling with these – this is called "the suffering of separation from what is loved".

This too is "not getting what one wants is also suffering". ⤵ In beings subject to aging… in beings subject to illness… in beings subject to death… in beings subject to sorrow, lamentation, pain, sadness, and despair such a wish arises: "Oh, that we were not subject to sorrow, lamentation, pain, sadness, and despair! content: Therein, what is the noble truth of the way leading to the ending of suffering? Refraining from false speech, refraining from divisive speech, refraining from harsh speech, refraining from idle chatter – this is called "right speech". ⤵ Therein, what is right action? Refraining from killing living beings, refraining from taking what is not given, refraining from sexual misconduct – this is called "right action". ⤵ Therein, what is right livelihood? Here a noble disciple, having abandoned wrong livelihood, makes a living by right livelihood – this is called "right livelihood". ⤵ Therein, what is right effort? Here a monk generates desire, strives, arouses energy, applies the mind, and endeavours for the non-arising of bad, unwholesome states that have not yet arisen. He generates desire, strives, arouses energy, applies the mind, and endeavours for the abandoning of bad, unwholesome states that have arisen. He generates desire, strives, arouses energy, applies the mind, and endeavours for the arising of wholesome states that have not yet arisen. content: There are four truths – suffering, the origin of suffering, the ending of suffering, and the way leading to the ending of suffering. ⤵ Therein, what is the origin of suffering? Craving – this is called "the origin of suffering". ⤵ Therein, what is suffering? The remaining defilements, the remaining unwholesome states, the three wholesome roots that are subject to the mental taints, the remaining wholesome states subject to the taints, the results of wholesome and unwholesome states subject to the taints, the states that are mere functioning – neither wholesome nor unwholesome nor the results of action – and all material form – this is called "suffering". ⤵ Therein, what is the ending of suffering? The abandoning of craving – this is called "the ending of suffering". ⤵ Therein, what is the way leading to the ending of suffering? Here, on an occasion when a monk develops the meditative absorption that is beyond the world, leading out of the round, leading to dismantling, for the abandoning of wrong views and for reaching the first stage – secluded from sense pleasures… he enters and dwells in the first meditative absorption, the way being difficult and direct knowledge slow – on that occasion there is the eightfold path: right view… right concentration. ⤵ Therein, what is right view? The wisdom, the understanding… the non-delusion, the investigation of states, the right view, the awakening factor of investigation of states that is a path factor, included in the path – this is called "right view". ⤵ Therein, what is right intention? The thinking, the thought… the right intention that is a path factor, included in the path – this is called "right intention". ⤵ Therein, what is right speech? The desisting, refraining, abstaining, and keeping away from the four kinds of verbal misconduct – the not doing, not committing, not transgressing, not overstepping the limit, the destroying of the causeway – the right speech that is a path factor, included in the path – this is called "right speech". ⤵ Therein, what is right action? The desisting, refraining, abstaining, and keeping away from the three kinds of bodily misconduct – the not doing, not committing, not transgressing, not overstepping the limit, the destroying of the causeway – the right action that is a path factor, included in the path – this is called "right action". ⤵ Therein, what is right livelihood? The desisting, refraining, abstaining, and keeping away from wrong livelihood – the not doing, not committing, not transgressing, not overstepping the limit, the destroying of the causeway – the right livelihood that is a path factor, included in the path – this is called "right livelihood". ⤵ Therein, what is right effort? The mental arousing of energy… the right effort, the awakening factor of energy that is a path factor, included in the path – this is called "right effort". ⤵ Therein, what is right mindfulness? The mindfulness, the remembering… the right mindfulness, the awakening factor of mindfulness that is a path factor, included in the path – this is called "right mindfulness". ⤵ Therein, what is right concentration? The steadiness of mind, the stability… the right concentration, the awakening factor of concentration that is a path factor, included in the path – this is called "right concentration". This is called "the way leading to the ending of suffering". The remaining states are associated with the way leading to the ending of suffering.

content: Therein, what is the eye faculty? The eye that is a sensitive surface derived from the four great elements… this is an empty village – this is called "the eye faculty". ⤵ Therein, what is the ear faculty… the nose faculty… the tongue faculty… the body faculty? The body that is a sensitive surface derived from the four great elements… this is an empty village – this is called "the body faculty". ⤵ Therein, what is the mind faculty? As a single class, the mind faculty is joined with contact. As a twofold class: there is mind with a root cause, and mind without a root cause. As a threefold class: there is wholesome mind, unwholesome mind, and neutral mind. As a fourfold class: there is mind belonging to the sense sphere, to the fine-material sphere, to the immaterial sphere, and mind not included in any sphere. As a fivefold class: there is mind joined with the faculty of pleasure, joined with the faculty of pain, joined with the faculty of gladness, joined with the faculty of sadness, and joined with the faculty of equanimity. As a sixfold class: there is eye-consciousness… mind-consciousness. This is the mind faculty as a sixfold class. ⤵ As a sevenfold class: there is eye-consciousness… body-consciousness, the mind element, and the mind-consciousness element. This is the mind faculty as a sevenfold class. ⤵ As an eightfold class: there is eye-consciousness… body-consciousness – which may be accompanied by pleasure or by pain – the mind element, and the mind-consciousness element. This is the mind faculty as an eightfold class. ⤵ As a ninefold class: there is eye-consciousness… body-consciousness, the mind element, and the mind-consciousness element – which may be wholesome, unwholesome, or neutral. This is the mind faculty as a ninefold class. ⤵ As a tenfold class: there is eye-consciousness… body-consciousness – which may be accompanied by pleasure or by pain – the mind element, and the mind-consciousness element – which may be wholesome, unwholesome, or neutral. This is the mind faculty as a tenfold class… thus the mind faculty is classified in many ways. This is called "the mind faculty". ⤵ Therein, what is the faculty of femininity? A woman's feminine features, feminine marks, feminine ways, feminine manner, femininity, the state of being a woman – this is called "the faculty of femininity". ⤵ Therein, what is the faculty of masculinity? A man's masculine features, masculine marks, masculine ways, masculine manner, masculinity, the state of being a man – this is called "the faculty of masculinity". ⤵ Therein, what is the life faculty? The life faculty is twofold: there is the material life faculty, and there is the immaterial life faculty. ⤵ Therein, what is the material life faculty? The life span of material states, their persistence, their keeping going, their being kept going, their continuing, their proceeding, their maintenance, their life, the life faculty – this is called "the material life faculty". ⤵ Therein, what is the immaterial life faculty? The life span of immaterial states, their persistence, their keeping going, their being kept going, their continuing, their proceeding, their maintenance, their life, the life faculty – this is called "the immaterial life faculty". This is called "the life faculty". ⤵ Therein, what is the faculty of pleasure? Bodily comfort, bodily pleasure; the comfortable, pleasant experience born of body-contact; the comfortable, pleasant feeling born of body-contact – this is called "the faculty of pleasure". ⤵ Therein, what is the faculty of pain? Bodily discomfort, bodily pain; the uncomfortable, painful experience born of body-contact; the uncomfortable, painful feeling born of body-contact – this is called "the faculty of pain". ⤵ Therein, what is the faculty of gladness? Mental comfort, mental pleasure; the comfortable, pleasant experience born of mind-contact; the comfortable, pleasant feeling born of mind-contact – this is called "the faculty of gladness". ⤵ Therein, what is the faculty of sadness? Mental discomfort, mental pain; the uncomfortable, painful experience born of mind-contact; the uncomfortable, painful feeling born of mind-contact – this is called "the faculty of sadness". ⤵ Therein, what is the faculty of equanimity? What is mentally neither comfortable nor uncomfortable; the experience born of mind-contact that is neither painful nor pleasant; the feeling born of mind-contact that is neither painful nor pleasant – this is called "the faculty of equanimity". ⤵ Therein, what is the faculty of confidence? The confidence, the trusting, the reliance, the deep trust; confidence, the faculty of confidence, the power of confidence – this is called "the faculty of confidence". ⤵ Therein, what is the faculty of energy? The mental arousing of energy, the exertion, the endeavour, the striving, the effort, the zeal, the persistence, the vigour, the steadiness, the unslackening endeavour, the not putting down of desire, the not putting down of the burden, the firm taking up of the burden; energy, the faculty of energy, the power of energy – this is called "the faculty of energy". ⤵ Therein, what is the faculty of mindfulness? The mindfulness, the remembering, the recollecting; mindfulness, the bearing in mind, the keeping in mind, the non-drifting, the non-forgetting; mindfulness, the faculty of mindfulness, the power of mindfulness, right mindfulness – this is called "the faculty of mindfulness". ⤵ Therein, what is the faculty of concentration? The steadiness of mind, the stability, the standing firm, the non-scattering, the non-distraction, the undistracted state of mind; calm, the faculty of concentration, the power of concentration, right concentration – this is called "the faculty of concentration". ⤵ Therein, what is the faculty of wisdom? The wisdom, the understanding… the non-delusion, the investigation of states, right view – this is called "the faculty of wisdom". ⤵ Therein, what is the faculty of "I shall know what is not yet known"? The wisdom, the understanding… the non-delusion, the investigation of states, the right view, the awakening factor of investigation of states that is a path factor, included in the path, for the realizing of those states not yet known, not yet seen, not yet reached, not yet found, not yet realized – this is called "the faculty of 'I shall know what is not yet known'". ⤵ Therein, what is the faculty of final knowledge? The wisdom, the understanding… the non-delusion, the investigation of states, the right view, the awakening factor of investigation of states that is a path factor, included in the path, for the realizing of those states that are known, seen, reached, found, and realized – this is called the faculty of final knowledge. ⤵ Therein, what is the faculty of one who has fully known? The wisdom, the understanding… the non-delusion, the investigation of states, the right view, the awakening factor of investigation of states that is a path factor, included in the path, of one who has fully known those states that are seen, reached, found, and realized – this is called "the faculty of one who has fully known".
